authority: named altair caller or its eval Task; generations persisted

dispatch.flow: worker ready/pull/claim; parent prepares exact compatible base and private paths before edits; submit binds dispatch generation/hash

information_format: fixed protocol atom keys; caller evidence/extra metadata normalized to bounded strings; no artifact atom interning

integration_validation.accept: persist clean HEAD compatible base and attributed pin before cherry-pick; no repin
integration_validation.land: clean current HEAD=candidate, single parent=accepted base, exact reserved diff, exact successful merge-tree result tree
integration_validation.legacy: pre-pinning accepted snapshots require reconcile/adopt/accept; never infer pin
integration_validation.retry: owner adopt new integration generation then accept; no retry after integrated

recover_land.cancel: normal newaccept or freshattempt cancels active recovery receipt, history retained
recover_land.receipt: immutable prior accept pin + original proposal + source reservation retained through adoption
recover_land.gate: current reservation, no active acceptance, unchanged proposal, no conflicting integrated identity; same exact candidate validation with historical parent base
recover_land.effects: durable integrated proof with recovery generations/provenance; no Git reset/cherry-pick

stage_binding.fresh_claim: archive and clear proofs/proposal/dispatch; no inheritance
